{"title":"Travi — one bit handled","raw_prompt":"A continuous FOUR-SECOND portrait paper-theatre shot. Start exactly at the supplied full-screen flat folio first frame and finish exactly at the supplied Travi-with-card last frame. This is Travary's successful-booking-save reaction; no new objects or UI text.

0–0.3 s: Travi peeks brightly over the folio in the supplied start pose. His eyes glance at the cream page, then eyebrows perk with pleased recognition.
0.3–1.6 s: he gently lowers the full-screen folio into the little navy folio at lower left, folding its cream working page closed like a practical paper prop. At the same time his grounded coral spinner body rolls slightly forward into its end mark at right, revealing his wheels and body from behind the folio. Continuous physical movement and sensible depth; do not shrink or melt Travi. Camera stays frontal; the paper landscape reappears smoothly behind the withdrawing folio in the end-frame composition.
1.6–2.8 s: Travi lifts and squares ONE large blank cream booking card in exactly the end-frame placement. Two folded-paper arms only: one supports its right edge, one fusses gently with the curled upper corner. A tiny playful pat on the cheeky corner, then an amused proud open grin. He is organising a booking, not performing an unrelated dance.
2.8–3.5 s: one small satisfied nod, eyes moving from the card toward the traveller, warm proud expression. Keep the eyes bright and normal sized; no sleepy half-lids or excessive bouncing.
3.5–4 s: settle precisely into the supplied last-frame card/body/face placement. Keep the card cream surface blank, held steadily and facing the camera. Allow the same modest curled corner as the end reference. Last half second motionless for a clean handoff to the settled UI.

IDENTITY LOCK: same coral upright ribbed hard-shell spinner, navy zipper/corners, brass twin handle rails, separate short navy handle, four dark grounded casters, cream palm luggage tag, exactly TWO sculpted folded-paper arms. Preserve original eyes, face proportions, smile, materials, and closed luggage silhouette. Accurate floor shadow. No hands multiplying or prop duplication.

STYLE / SET LOCK: same handcrafted textured Bali paper theatre, teal sky, orange sun, cream clouds, temples, palms, terraces, blue ocean, sandy floor. Rich warm holiday lighting, beautiful dimensional cut-paper craft. Preserve quiet upper heading and lower action zones. Only the folio, card and character move; no camera rotation, scene cut, confetti, other mascot, leg growth, body morphing, random landmarks or plastic render.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, digits, prices, UI controls, boarding codes, watermarks, captions or audio. Blank page/card surfaces are intentional because the app renders actual booking details and actions separately. Silent.","duration_seconds":4,"aspect_ratio":"9:16","resolution":"720p","camera_move":"frontal locked","first_frame_path":"1791401076499-d5cfd5b8a3dd175d.png","last_frame_path":"1791401076516-adc7ce82d9e9ee8b.png"}
